svg.aria-label: Core AI Platform - eight workstreams of the Mizan 3 judicial AI sub-system

g.text: Mizan 3 · Judicial AI Sub-System · eight coordinated workstreams, running on-premise
Digitises incoming case documents, then auto-classifies and routes them
Handwriting recognition across mixed print / handwritten layouts
Domain LLM fine-tuned on judicial corpora, backed by semantic retrieval
Keyword + semantic search, natural-language query, auto-summaries
Grounded, source-linked answers over live case data
Turns hearing transcripts into structured minutes and hearing text
Outcome prediction with confidence scores plus precedent recall
End-to-end service integration, documentation and technical handover
